$comment: Bare launch profile for the Rendered Codex tab (plan Design 1-3, 6-8, § P6). Read by src-tauri/src/bare/ at every bare Codex spawn (agent.rs spawn_codex_appserver, pty.rs spawn_pty). Placeholders: {{root}} = the Vidar install root, {{home}} = the agentHomes folder (contracts/paths.json), both absolute at spawn; {{localappdata}} = the spawning process's own real LOCALAPPDATA (Vidar's, or Falcon's for a hosted spawn), refused when unset, relative or inside the Bare home (src-tauri/src/bare/env.rs), because a Codex shell's TEMP is built from it and a redirected folder that was never created leaves pwsh in ConstrainedLanguage. `binary` is the D7 resolver: the first allowlisted Path folder holding one of `shims` and `script` under it (never APPDATA); the version is read from `package`. The Rendered spawn is `<node> <script> app-server`; the Raw row (pty.rs) spawns `<node> <script> <rawArgs>`, the TUI in the tab's PTY: `--no-daemon` keeps it off the shared background server (outside the tab's process tree), `--no-alt-screen` runs it inline so the `[Vidar Bare: ...]` warning line stays in scrollback. `execArgs` is the one-shot line only the runes probe builds (tools/bare/probe-runes.mjs, `Surface::Exec`): `--no-daemon` is a top-level flag so it sits before `exec`, `--skip-git-repo-check` because the probe cwd is a temp folder, `--color never` for a plain reply; the probe appends `-o <file>` and the prompt after the `--profile`. All use an env built from contracts/agent-env.json plus `overlay`; the config template is generated into `configTarget` under the home on every launch. `setsPayload` is the template the session's Rune Vault text and copied skill-rune listing fill, built into {{home}}\layer\payload-<hash12>.md and supplied as developer instructions by the selected Codex surface (src-tauri/src/bare/mod.rs); `configTarget` keeps an inert developer-instructions baseline while the vault payload is active. `assets` is what tools/sandbox/check-zip.ps1 requires in the release zip.
